% a formalized statement prints a "Lean" mark linking to its Lean formalization. In a numbered
% display (equation, align), the mark goes at the right margin, before the number of the line
% where \leancheck appears; in an unnumbered display, it takes the place of the number.
% Website: \newcommand\leanmapurl{<address>} before \input{leananchors} overrides the default.
% Mark: likewise \newcommand\leancheckmark{...}.

\def\leancheck@link#1{\href{\leanmapurl\#label=#1}{\leancheckmark}}
% Display math: an unnumbered display gets the mark as its tag; otherwise the mark is kept in
% \leancheck@eqmark and printed by \tagform@ with the line's number (not during the measuring
% pass of align, which would put it on the wrong line). Not \maketag@@@, which showkeys hooks.
\def\leancheck@eqmark{}
\def\leancheck@display#1{%
  \ifst@rred\tag*{\leancheck@link{#1}}%
  \else\ifmeasuring@\else\gdef\leancheck@eqmark{\leancheck@link{#1}\quad}\fi\fi}
\let\leancheck@tagform\tagform@
\def\tagform@#1{\hbox{\normalfont\leancheck@eqmark}\global\let\leancheck@eqmark\@empty
